file_role: Machine-readable manifest for the three-way cross-project benchmark (UnLuaNova / slua-unreal / FUnLua). Consumed by bootstrap_external.py (prepare / check / status).
honesty_note: This manifest describes HOW to reproduce a comparison, not a result. No commit hash is invented here: every 'pin' is UNKNOWN until a maintainer performs a real checkout and records the exact commit that was actually built and run. No performance numbers, ratios, or conclusions are stored. See Docs/CN/CrossProject_Benchmark.md and Docs/EN/CrossProject_Benchmark.md.

alignment_reference.note: All three projects must be run on the same machine, engine, config, carrier, case set and iteration counts. runner.py and metrics.py enforce this fail-closed; a comparison table is only legitimate after all three have aligned real runs.

readme_2_08x_boundary.meaning: UnLuaNova self-comparison: Luau vs Lua 5.5.1 on the historical UE 5.8.3 baseline (2026-10-24), same machine and build.
readme_2_08x_boundary.is_not: Not a comparison against slua-unreal or FUnLua. No 'faster than slua' claim is made anywhere in this repository.
readme_2_08x_boundary.evidence: README.md (the 2.08x row and the 'Conditions / self-baseline / not a same-machine comparison against slua-unreal / FUnLua' notes).

unluanova.repo_url_note: Local 'git remote origin' of this checkout, read on 2026-11-15; not a claim about any other fork.
unluanova.pin_source: Maintainer must record the exact commit hash of the tree that was actually built and benchmarked. Fill after a real run; do not infer from HEAD or from a tag name alone.
unluanova.license_evidence: LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY.md: 'The repository root license is MIT'. Root license covers only UnLuaNova's own source; vendored components keep their own licenses.
unluanova.ue_version_note: Confirm the exact engine version actually used for the run. It must be identical to the engine used by the two external projects. The runner template's '5.8.3' is illustrative only, not a verified requirement.

workload.note: README.md: 'UnLuaNova side implementation ... pending a real run in a real project to confirm every UE call is reachable'. The workload entry has NOT been confirmed in a real build by this tool.

expected_layout.note: This project is the repository itself, not a clone. Its 'structure' is validated via the in-repo workload contract files, which the check command verifies directly.

unluanova.note: Baseline side of the three-way comparison. Has framework code and a self-comparison baseline (Lua 5.5.1 vs Luau) but NO real cross-project run record. A single-project self-baseline is not a cross-project conclusion.

notes: Current cross-project conclusion: NOT ESTABLISHED. No real cross-project run records exist in Tools/CrossProject/results/.
The README's 2.08x is UnLuaNova's Lua-5.5.1-vs-Luau self-comparison; it is not a comparison with slua-unreal or FUnLua.

A comparison table is legitimate ONLY after all three projects have aligned real runs (same machine / engine / config / carrier / case set / iteration counts) validated fail-closed by runner.py and metrics.py.
CI does not run this benchmark: it requires real UE engine builds of three separate projects on one machine, which is outside CI. See Docs/EN/CrossProject_Benchmark.md.
'UNKNOWN' values are intentional. They are blanks for maintainers to fill after real, verifiable checkouts and runs - not values to be guessed.
